subject.title: [Bug]: xAI/Grok "could not decrypt encrypted_content" 400 trips the per-model circuit breaker (no auto-recovery)

question: For the linked fix PR, should maintainers accept source-level reproduction plus redacted pre-fix xAI logs as sufficient proof for this non-client-inducible provider rotation error?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the provider-side xAI snapshot/key rotation that emits the exact code-less message cannot be forced during a normal review run.

options.title: Accept source and pre-fix proof
options.body: Allow the linked narrow predicate/test fix to proceed once ordinary code review and CI are satisfied, noting that after-fix organic xAI proof can be added later if the provider rotation recurs.

options.title: Require organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the linked PR blocked until a real xAI rotation event occurs and produces redacted after-fix logs showing the retry path succeeds.

recommendation.title: Accept source and pre-fix proof
recommendation.body: Allow the linked narrow predicate/test fix to proceed once ordinary code review and CI are satisfied, noting that after-fix organic xAI proof can be added later if the provider rotation recurs.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior encrypted-reasoning retry recovery and current predicate history point to steipete as the best available routing owner for this proof-sufficiency choice.
